issues.issue: Claims the redness endpoint was 'not met' for Protocol 05-003-13, but the only citation discusses ocular itching p-values and contains nothing supporting a redness failure for this trial.

The itching 'p<0.001 at all post-challenge time points' is supported only by an aggregate 'Phase 3 CAC studies' quote, not by data specific to Protocol 05-003-11, so the per-trial result is weakly supported.

States 'p<0.001 at all post-challenge time points' for 09-003-05, but the cited line-56 quote only says 'successful for ocular itching'; the p-value is drawn from a separate table citation whose column attribution to this trial is not clearly established.
